high_level_description: The image shows an informational plaque displayed in what appears to be a museum or historical exhibit. The plaque is bilingual, with text in Arabic and English, providing details about a portrait of Augustus, the first Roman emperor. Text Content: Arabic Text (Top Section): The Arabic text discusses the significance of the portrait, mentioning its role in spreading Augustus' image throughout the Roman Empire and how his expression embodies the return to order at the beginning of his reign.
